answer: The gale graph is validated at intake and the copper frontier is published, and as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and willow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1879 impostors cost 448 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
